notes: 8 traps and 0 junctions become 8 sites; 28 paths join traps through junctions, all on one shared transport channel with 12 waveforms, one per motion.
Durations are whole microseconds from the machine's cost model (corrected): a path is its split, segments, junction crossings and merge; R 5 µs, MS 25 µs, readout 120 µs, pumping 50 µs.
2 gate zones get one calibration per exact waveform of the program (7 waveforms), on their own optical channels; a broadcast R reaches every gate zone, one ion per zone.
1 closed loop(s) (L0) each drive their ions on one mandatory transport channel: a rotation moves every ion on the loop one slot, in one event.
Routing: this site's router (qccd.cert.planner), proposing; QCCDCert's routing-proposal stage admitted every transport with its legality proof.
